evidence.section: 4.2 Responsible Mechanisms for the High Strength
evidence.quote: As for as-aged alloy, the precipitation hardening of basal precipitates should be effective.
The ingots of Mg-3Sm-1Nd-0.6Zn-0.4Zr alloy with 90 mm in diameter were produced by semi-continuous casting.
The ingots were homogenized at 520 °C for 12 h and then quenched into hot water of ~ 80 °C.
Before extrusion, the cylindrical bars were preheated at 320 °C for 1 h.
Hot extrusion was made at 320 °C with an extrusion ratio of ~ 6:1 at a ram speed of 0.3 mm/s.
